papers.title: A vector-contraction inequality for Rademacher complexities
papers.findings: Theorem3/Cor4 vector contraction for coupled Lipschitz losses; multiclass iid labeled example pp4-5. Independent auxiliary output signs are not new label observations. Section4 separates coupled function classes from coordinate-product supersets and assumes explicit norm budgets for linear/RKHS bounds. Section6 refutes the simpler single-sign Hilbert-norm conjecture.
papers.limits: Selected statements/examples pp1-9, proof closing pp13-14 and referencesp15 read. Auxiliary lemmas pp10-12 and finalp16 not read; no complete proof certification, reproduction or independent scientific review. No generic loss-specific bound attributed as a new Q theorem.
